Current large language model (LLM)-based conversational agents lack embodiment and the expressive gestures essential for natural interaction. Existing solutions for ECAs often produce rigid, low-diversity motions, that are unsuitable for human-like interaction. top_papers.title: Utonia: Toward One Encoder for All Point Clouds
top_papers.abstract: We dream of a future where point clouds from all domains can come together to shape a single model that benefits them all.
